title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government has published a response to a report on Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards, outlining their approach to addressing its recommendations. The response likely details their plans and proposals to regulate and develop artificial intelligence in a way that balances public benefits with potential risks and challenges.

title: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education
description: The Department for Education’s (DfE) position on the use of generative AI in the education sector.
summary: The Department for Education has a policy on generative artificial intelligence in education. This policy sets out the DfE's position on the use of AI tools that generate content, such as essays and answers.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual outlines their approach to regulating artificial intelligence (AI) in qualifications, such as exams and assessments. The document aims to address the growing use of AI in this sector, as requested by the UK government's education and science ministers.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This report assesses the intersection of copyright and artificial intelligence, examining how copyrighted works are used in AI development. It evaluates the impact of this relationship on copyright law and rights holders.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has responded to a report from the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence, addressing concerns and recommendations. The response aims to ensure the UK's position as a leading tech nation while mitigating potential risks associated with AI.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: The document outlines the scope of work for a committee reviewing the relationship between artificial intelligence and public standards. The review aims to provide guidance on how artificial intelligence can be integrated into public standards and services.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The government has submitted evidence to a parliamentary committee examining how to regulate the development and use of artificial intelligence. The document is a contribution to the inquiry on AI governance.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: The document discusses the potential impact of artificial intelligence on the regulation of medical products, aiming to understand its effects and implications. It involves implementing the principles outlined in the AI White Paper to guide this understanding and regulation.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the Defence organisation the most effective, efficient, and trusted in the world for its size. This vision involves achieving influential use of AI in Defence capabilities.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Department for Transport (DfT) has created an action plan to leverage the benefits of artificial intelligence in the transport sector while mitigating potential risks. The plan outlines how the DfT will work with the transport industry to harness the opportunities presented by AI.
